intent_record.intent_summary: Add buffer length validation guards to prevent out-of-bounds reads when parsing SCTP address parameters.
intent_record.what: Added two boundary validation checks before processing SCTP address parameters: first verifies that addrs_len is at least sizeof(*param) to safely read the parameter header, then reads the parameter length and verifies that addrs_len is at least that length before further processing.
intent_record.how: These checks prevent out-of-bounds memory reads when parsing the raw address list. Without them, the code could read beyond the allocated buffer when accessing param->length or passing insufficient data to af->from_addr_param(). The checks enforce that the input buffer contains complete, valid parameter structures before dereferencing or processing them.

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove redundant len variable reassignment in loop iteration to eliminate unnecessary computation.
intent_record.what: Removed the line `len = ntohs(param->length);` from the loop iteration in the sctp_raw_to_bind_addrs function, specifically from the code path after the 'next:' label.
intent_record.how: This removal eliminates a redundant reassignment of the `len` variable within each loop iteration. The variable `len` is already assigned earlier in the loop body (before the 'next:' label is reached via goto), so this statement was recalculating the same value unnecessarily on each iteration, wasting CPU cycles without changing the functional outcome.

intent_record.intent_summary: Consolidate and reorder variable declarations for improved code organization and readability.
intent_record.what: Reordered variable declarations in the sctp_unpack_cookie function: moved the declaration of 'unsigned int len, chlen;' before 'enum sctp_scope scope;', and removed the separate 'unsigned int len;' declaration that appeared after scope.
intent_record.how: This change consolidates two related unsigned int variable declarations into a single line and repositions them earlier in the declaration block. At runtime, this has no functional impact—the variables are still declared in the same scope with identical semantics. The consolidation may improve code clarity by grouping related types together.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add comprehensive boundary validation for SCTP cookie chunk length and address list length to prevent buffer overread vulnerabilities.
intent_record.what: Replaced a single length check with three separate validation checks: (1) extract ntohs(ch->length) into variable chlen, (2) add lower bound check that chlen must be at least sizeof(struct sctp_init_chunk), (3) keep the upper bound check using chlen, and (4) add a new check validating that bear_cookie->raw_addr_list_len does not exceed remaining buffer space after accounting for both fixed_size and chlen.
intent_record.how: The original code only validated that the chunk length did not exceed available buffer space. The new code adds a minimum size validation to prevent processing undersized chunks, and introduces an additional boundary check for raw_addr_list_len to prevent buffer overread when accessing the address list within the cookie structure. These checks prevent potential out-of-bounds memory access and ensure structural integrity before dereferencing cookie fields.
